title: Quad-layout contract (network contraction) stage: 1.5 s to under 100 ms
description: Make the `contract` stage of QuadLayoutEngine fast. It takes 1.475 s today. Log: 3000+ collapses with up to 16479 splits growing the mesh to V=54959, relabel floods touching 898827 faces (0.131 s), recarve 0.17 s. Baseline, measured 2026-10-15 with `uv run ixdar-cli run-scene --scene quad-layout --property quadLayoutScene.alpha=15` on the default model (headless, 9.1 s to ready): cross field 0.395 s, seamless 0.800 s, motorcycle graph 0.145 s, quantization 1.526 s, carve 0.674 s, contract 1.475 s, global grid map 1.897 s. These run synchronously before the scene's first frame, so together they are almost all of the quad-layout scene's time to first paint. The user's goal is first paint under 0.1 s; a sibling ticket moves the pipeline off the first frame, and each stage ticket makes one stage as fast as it can go. Target: this stage under 100 ms on the default model, or as close as the algorithm allows, with the reason it can go no lower. The stage's output must not change: same singularity count, arc/node/patch counts, quad count and a screenshot that image-diffs clean against the master baseline. Use the stage's own `[quad-layout] <stage>` log line and an async-profiler capture (`run-scene --profile`, read with `ixdar-cli profile-report`). Stay inside this stage's package; touch shared code (solver/, HalfEdgeMesh, QuadLayoutEngine) only where the stage needs it, and list every shared-file change in the report, because six sibling tickets run in parallel. Related: CRAW-2 (scan-scale pipeline), CRAW-4 (cached layouts).
definition-of-done:
1. The stage's `[quad-layout] contract` time on the default quad-layout model is recorded before and after (median of 3 runs) in changes-made, with the after time under 100 ms or a stated reason it cannot be. 2. Singularity count, arc/node/patch counts and quad count match master exactly. 3. A screenshot of the final layout under tmp/ image-diffs clean against a master screenshot taken the same way. 4. No debugging scaffolding is left behind; `ixd wt done` passes.

5. Whole-suite check: `python3 /home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/run_suite.py --checkout <this worktree> --out /home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/<ticket> --compare /home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/master-0f52d26f` covers sphere_base, sphere_random, bolt, hand, fandisk, elk, feline, fertility, botijo, block, Hand-tri-30k, rockerarm, buddha and the crawfish scan (~/crawfish/IMG_4109.glb, 8 GB heap). Every mesh reports MATCH against the master baseline: the same status (a mesh master fails on must fail the same way), the same count signature, and an identical screenshot. The per-mesh stage times before/after go in changes-made. A DIFF stops for a user ruling.
testing-plan: 1. On master: run-scene quad-layout three times, record the stage time and counts, take a screenshot. 2. In the worktree: the same three runs plus a profile capture; compare times and counts. 3. image-diff the two screenshots. 4. mvn test for the touched packages.
unknowns: Whether the stage can reach 100 ms without changing its output; if not, what the floor is and why
changes-made: Relaunch A/B (botijo default, alpha=15, machine load ~17 so noisy): master contract 1.755/2.769/3.427 s, worktree (previous agent's partial diff) 2.063/2.616/1.461 s; counts identical (singularities 72, recarve nodes 446 arcs 908 patches 454, quads 14444). Section timers: arc collapses ~1.0 s (Dijkstra tryRoute ~0.75 s, running in C1-compiled code for nearly the whole stage: PrintCompilation shows its C2 version deopted by an uncommon trap), per-round validate ~0.145 s over 17 rounds, shortestZeroArc scan ~0.11 s, recarve ~0.30 s, initial labelPatchCovers ~0.04 s, conform ~0.04 s.

Milestone 2 (worktree, botijo alpha=15, counts unchanged): per-round validate/flank checks run once after the rounds (debug flag keeps per-round); recarve requirePartition floods once (second flood only on failure, for the message); ArcRerouter walks face corners through flat half-edge arrays, keeps per-node search state interleaved in one int[] and expands settled nodes in their own method (called per node, so it reaches C2 within ms instead of tryRoute's profiled C1). Contract 0.84/0.86 s (Dijkstra search 0.31 s, was ~0.47-0.50).

Relaunch 2 A/B (botijo alpha=15, interleaved, flock'd, load ~9): master contract 1.496/1.378/1.584 s (median 1.496), worktree 0.827/0.828/0.812 s (median 0.827). All six screenshots share sha256 22e54fa9d8a1; count lines identical except the relabel diagnostics (dedup of aliased touched patches: 12299 vs 13384 floods).

Relaunch 2, final A/B (botijo alpha=15, interleaved, flock'd, load ~9): master contract 1.522/1.492/1.386 s (median 1.492), worktree 0.919/0.871/0.930 s (median 0.919). Six screenshots identical (sha256 22e54fa9d8a1); singularities 72, recarve nodes 446 arcs 908 patches 454, count lines identical to master (only relabel diagnostics differ). Changes this relaunch: expandSettledNode inlined back into ArcRerouter.tryRoute (the SingleCallerHelper hook requires it; costs ~0.09 s against the 0.827 s median of the extracted form, because tryRoute's per-route C2 compile deopts). Tried and dropped: A* with a shrunk Euclidean bound (settled nodes 347k -> 283k, search time unchanged). Section timers (removed): Dijkstra search ~0.35-0.39 s over ~9.3k routes / 347k settled nodes (~1 us per node, ~4 relaxations each, memory-bound), edge-split materialization ~0.06 s, finishCollapse ~0.10 s (relabel 0.06-0.08), recarve ~0.17 s, shortestZeroArc scan ~0.07 s, labelPatchCovers ~0.025 s, conform ~0.02 s, final validate ~0.01 s.

DoD 5 suite (fresh run against master-0f52d26f): all 14 meshes MATCH (status, count signature, screenshot). sphere_random, fandisk, Hand-tri-30k and crawfish fail to load on master and the same way here, so the contraction pipeline is not exercised end to end on them (Hand-tri-30k does reach contract). Contract stage master -> worktree (s): sphere_base 0.088->0.056, bolt 0.193->0.126, hand 0.540->0.543, elk 1.007->0.857, feline 3.038->1.424, fertility 0.882->0.539, botijo 1.346->0.939, block 0.919->0.717, Hand-tri-30k 0.879->0.591, rockerarm 1.065->0.872, buddha 2.985->1.701 (single runs, machine load ~9).

Handover: wt done passed (diagnostics clean, build, launch entry run, REVIEW). 68 unit tests across the embedding/contraction classes pass. Screenshots tmp/craw-71-master-botijo.png vs tmp/craw-71-worktree-botijo.png image-diff ok (byte-identical). 100 ms not reached: botijo contract median 0.919 s (master 1.492 s). Floor: ~9.3k arc re-routes settle ~347k search nodes at ~1 us each (memory-bound; A* does not cut the time), plus ~16.5k edge splits, the recarve (~0.17 s) and relabel floods (~0.07 s), all on a cold JVM before first paint. Getting lower needs fewer or cheaper re-routes, which changes the algorithm, not just its implementation.
